$comment: Banned dependencies. Keys are npm package names as pnpm-lock.yaml records them in its packages section; the checker scans the full lockfile (transitive included), so a ban here blocks any path of arrival. Extend with a reason - a ban without one will be questioned at review. Advisory acceptance (vulnerabilities that are accepted rather than bans) lives in pnpm-workspace.yaml auditConfig.ignoreGhsas - pnpm's native mechanism, mirrored here because JSON cannot carry comments: GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (CVE-2026-93687, high, braces stack-exhaustion DoS on deeply nested patterns) has no patched release (braces@3.0.3 is the latest) and cannot be dropped from the tree; it arrives via micromatch@4 from deepagents (production) and the web lint toolchain (dev), and braces() only matches internally configured globs, never request-controlled patterns; re-check on any braces, micromatch, deepagents, or eslint-config-next bump.
